Win+Shift+S snips any part of your screen.
Win+V shows your clipboard history (turn it on the first time).
Win+. opens emoji and symbols. 🍡
Win+D shows the desktop. Press it again to bring everything back.
Win+Z shows snap layouts for the window you're in.
Ctrl+Shift+Esc opens Task Manager directly.
Win+Ctrl+D makes a fresh virtual desktop. Win+Ctrl+Left/Right to switch.

Ctrl+P opens any file by name. Type :42 to jump to line 42.
Ctrl+Shift+P opens the Command Palette: every command, one search away.
Alt+Up/Down moves the current line. Add Shift to copy it instead.
Ctrl+D selects the next match too. Multi-cursor magic! ✨
F2 renames a symbol everywhere it's used.
Ctrl+` toggles the built-in terminal.
Alt+Shift+D splits the pane in Windows Terminal.
Ctrl+Shift+F searches the terminal output.
Ctrl+R searches your PowerShell history.
Ctrl+L clears the screen in PowerShell.
Ctrl+Shift+N makes a new folder right here. 📁
Alt+Up goes up one folder.
Ctrl+T opens a new File Explorer tab.
Ctrl+Shift+C copies the selected file's path.
Ctrl+Shift+T brings back the tab you just closed.
Ctrl+L jumps straight to the address bar.
Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+8 jump to a tab. Ctrl+9 goes to the last one.
Middle-click a link to open it in a new tab.
Ctrl+; types today's date into the cell. 📅
Ctrl+Arrow jumps to the edge of your data.
F4 repeats your last action, or toggles $ references in a formula.
Ctrl+T turns your range into a table with filters.
Alt+= adds a quick SUM.
Shift+F3 cycles UPPER, lower and Title case.
Ctrl+Enter starts a new page.
Alt+Shift+Up/Down moves the whole paragraph.
F5 starts the slideshow. Shift+F5 starts from this slide.
Press B during a slideshow to black the screen. Press again to return.
Ctrl+D duplicates the selected slide or shape.
Ctrl+N starts a new email.
Ctrl+R replies. Ctrl+Shift+R replies to all.
Ctrl+Shift+M mutes or unmutes you in a call.
Ctrl+Shift+O turns your camera on or off.
Ctrl+E jumps to search.
Ctrl+K jumps to any channel or person.
Ctrl+Shift+A shows all your unreads.
Press Up in an empty message box to edit your last message.
Ctrl+K opens the quick switcher.
Ctrl+Shift+M toggles your mic.
Alt+A mutes or unmutes you.
Alt+V turns your video on or off.
F5 stamps the current time and date.
Ctrl+N opens a new tab. Ctrl+W closes it.
Ctrl+/ opens quick actions.
Shift+A wraps your selection in auto layout.
Ctrl+O opens the quick switcher.
Ctrl+P opens the command palette.
Ctrl+P searches every page.
Type / to add any block.
